# [CS011] Request Body Bound to Database Model (api-mass-assignment)

A request body is decoded into a database model that has privileged fields.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | HIGH |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-915](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/915.html) |
| **OWASP** | A01:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Decoding JSON into the model you save lets the client set any exported field it names, such as {"is_admin": true} or a balance. A model is recognized by ORM tags (gorm, db, bun, sql, bson, xorm) or by being saved in the same function. Decode into a request type with only the editable fields and copy them.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
func update(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var u User // has IsAdmin and gorm tags
	_ = json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&u)
	db.Save(&u)
}
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
type UpdateProfileRequest struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

func update(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req UpdateProfileRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "bad request", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	u := currentUser(r)
	u.Name = req.Name
	db.Save(u)
}
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [api-mass-assignment]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    api-mass-assignment: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore api-mass-assignment -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** api-mass-assignment
```
